test.create_query: CREATE TABLE date_preimage_perf ( id UInt64, seen DateTime('UTC'), d Date, INDEX idx_seen seen TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_d d TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS index_granularity = 256
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO date_preimage_perf SELECT number AS id, toDateTime(1772323200 + intDiv(number, 25000000) * 86400 + number % 86400, 'UTC') AS seen, toDate(seen) AS d FROM numbers(50000000)
